//: ChampionCHIP RVBL-2 multicycle RISC-V core — OpenLane 1 config.
//1: Design dir is the repo root (OpenLane 1 expects config.json there).
//2: hence the dir::rtl/... paths. Runs land in ./runs/ which is
//3: gitignored; config.json itself is a required submission file
//6: resolves against rtl/ — the same -I rtl the iverilog builds use.
//7: clk_i / rst_i are the only top-level inputs; halt_o the only
//8: output. Reset is synchronous throughout (handoff decision 12),
//9: so rst_i is an ordinary data input, not a reset pin to the PDK.
//10: STARTING POINT ONLY — 40 ns = 25 MHz. The guide never states a
//11: target frequency, so this is ours to choose. The 32x32 combinational
//12: multiplier (mult.v, flagged as the design's largest block) is the
//13: expected critical path. Read the post-STA slack from the first run
//14: and tighten or relax from there rather than guessing again.
//15: Let the floorplanner size the die from utilisation on the first
//16: run. Once area is known, switch to an explicit DIE_AREA if a
//17: fixed footprint is needed for the report's GDSII image.
//18: imem/dmem are behavioural arrays with no PDK macro behind them,
//19: so yosys maps them to standard-cell flops and mux trees. See the
//20: memory-sizing note in the report before trusting the area number.
